verses.label: Chorus
lines: For your friends are my friends,
And my friends are your friends.

measuredNoteEdits.reason: "在一起" repeats the line before it (52.31 D4, 52.77 D4, 53.21 E4) a fourth lower: 在 54.31, 一 54.50, 起 on the F#4 at 54.78. English verse 1 has the same shape (to-geth-er: A3 A3 F#4). The matcher had left the second note without a word.
English verse 2 sings "get to-geth-er" on B4 A4 G4 D4 (32.47-33.20). Here 同在一起 has B4 69.38, A4 69.65, G4 69.90, then E4-D4; the matcher had left the A4 without a word and put 在 and 一 one note late.
Mandarin verse 1 sings 其快乐无比 as two notes, then three on A3 and D4 (59.64 A3 乐, 60.45 A3 无, 60.91 D4 比). Here the A3 starts at 71.99; the matcher had left its first 0.28 s without a word.
The line 当我们同在一起 starts on the D4 after the 0.4 s breath, as in the same line at 49.66 s and 68.08 s (D4 F#4 A4). The short D4 at 55.23 s is the falling end of 起 before the breath.
其快乐无比 starts on the D4 after the breath (58.87 s), matching English "The happier we'll be" (21.55 D4, 33.74 D4).
"The more we get together" starts D4 F#4 A4 at 31.18 s, the same as 49.66 s and 68.08 s. The D4 at 30.67 s is the last "friends" of the line before.
See the pin at 31.18 s: "And my friends are your friends" ends on this D4.
起 of the second 在一起 is the jump up to F#4 (54.71-54.94 s), as English "to-geth-er" ends on F#4 (17.86 s). The D4 at 55.23 s is its falling end.
